buttons.label: Professional email with proposal
buttons.prompt: Write a professional email to [client / colleague / company] where I propose [your idea or proposal]. The tone should be [formal / friendly / enthusiastic].

buttons.label: Meeting for demo
buttons.prompt: Write a professional email to a potential client where I propose a meeting to show them a demo of our virtual reality solution.

sections.title: ✍️ Improve an email you've already written

buttons.label: Improve existing email
buttons.prompt: Improve this email to make it sound clearer and more professional, but keep the original message: [Paste your email here]

buttons.label: Shorten email
buttons.prompt: Make this email more brief and direct, without losing courtesy or clarity: [Paste your email here]

buttons.label: Follow-up without response
buttons.prompt: Write a friendly and professional follow-up email for someone who hasn't responded to my proposal sent [X days/a week] ago.

buttons.label: Template for potential clients
buttons.prompt: Create an email template to contact potential clients interested in [your product or service]. It should be brief, with a clear call to action.

buttons.label: Request something specific
buttons.prompt: Write a polite email to request [a meeting / feedback / a document / more information] from [name or type of person].

buttons.label: Professional
buttons.prompt: Convert this email to a more professional tone, without changing the main content: [Paste your text]

buttons.label: Cordial
buttons.prompt: Convert this email to a warmer tone, without changing the main content: [Paste your text]

buttons.label: Inspiring
buttons.prompt: Convert this email to a more inspiring tone, without changing the main content: [Paste your text]

buttons.label: Informal but respectful
buttons.prompt: Convert this email to a more informal but respectful tone, without changing the main content: [Paste your text]

buttons.label: Assertive but diplomatic
buttons.prompt: Convert this email to a more assertive but diplomatic tone, without changing the main content: [Paste your text]

buttons.label: Email with variables
buttons.prompt: Write an email to {{client_name}} thanking them for their interest in {{product}} and proposing a call on {{day}} at {{time}}.
